q.line: It's lonely here, there's no one left to torture
stanza: Give me back my broken night, my mirrored room, my secret life
It's lonely here, there's no one left to torture
Give me absolute control over every living soul
And lie beside me, baby, that's an order!

q.line: All these poses of classical torture
stanza: Reclined amongst these packs of reasons
